text_block_list.text:
To become an Umamusume
who surpasses Symboli Rudolf, the "Emperor"――

Within the major milestone of the "first 3 years,"
Tokai Teio brilliantly seized her dream.

Tokai Teio made her appearance today full of energy,
leaping right over the track rail as usual.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Of course! After all, starting today,
Trainer and I are setting sail on a brand new voyage!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Considering our three years together, I already knew we'd keep our partnership going, but still...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, if you don't properly tell me we're continuing,
I can't help but feel anxious, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Seizing this dream was all thanks to you, Trainer!
I'll be in trouble if we aren't together from here on out too, you hear!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And so, let us venture forth to seize a new dream~!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! My dream is to keep running
foreeeever alongside you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, here we go!
Training, start!
